rounds.sentence: Naho mulilo wo vha muhulwane, o vha na mbilu ya u gidimela ngomu a tshidza ṅwana.
options: tshithu tsha muvhilini tshi pompa malofha
rounds.story: Maipfi 'mulilo' na 'a tshidza ṅwana' a sumbedza uri mbilu hafha ndi u sa ofha.

rounds.sentence: Tshikolo tshi na ṱhoho ntswa ye ya thoma nga Musumbuluwo.
options: fhungo ḽa ndeme ḽa bugu kana nyambo
rounds.story: 'Tshikolo' na 'ntswa' zwi sumbedza murangaphanḓa wa tshikolo, hu si ṱhoho ya muvhilini.

rounds.sentence: U songo shela maḓi nga mulomo muṱuku wa boṱelo u sa sedzi.
options: vhupo ha u ḽa na u amba
vhuimo ha u dzhena kana u bva ha tshithu
vhupo hune mulambo wa fhelela hone
rounds.story: 'shela maḓi' na 'boṱelo' zwi sumbedza mulomo wa tshiselo, ndi vulaḽa ha hone.

rounds.sentence: Nḓila ya u bika mukapu uyu yo leluwa vhukuma.
rounds.story: 'u bika' na 'yo leluwa' zwi amba maitele kana nḓila ya u ita tshithu.

rounds.sentence: Mushumisani o vhala tshelede nga vhuronwane a sa ṱavhanyi.
rounds.story: 'tshelede' na 'nga vhuronwane' zwi sumbedza u vhala mbalo, hu si u guda maṅwalo.

rounds.sentence: Musi hu tshi rothola, o vala nguvho yawe khulwane.
options: u tswala kana u vala muvothi
rounds.story: 'hu tshi rothola' na 'nguvho' zwi sumbedza u ambara, hu si u tswala.

rounds.sentence: Ni songo dovha na ṱalutshedza, ndo no pfa zwine na amba.
options: u pfa vhutungu kana u kwama
rounds.story: 'ni songo dovha na ṱalutshedza' i sumbedza uri o no pfesesa.

rounds.sentence: Uyu munna u bva Ha-Mashau, ndi hone hune a aluswa hone.
options: u huma kana u ya nnḓa
u bvelela hune wa aluswa hone
rounds.story: 'Ha-Mashau' na 'hune a aluswa hone' zwi sumbedza fhethu hune muthu a bva hone.

rounds.sentence: Musi ro no ṱuwa roṱhe, ene o dzula henefho a fhedza mushumo.
options: u sala fhethu u sa ṱuwe
rounds.story: 'ro no ṱuwa roṱhe' na 'henefho' zwi sumbedza uri o sala a sa ṱuwi.

rounds.sentence: Vho-Rammbi vha ḓo ima tshigwada tshashu kha muṱangano wa matshelo.
options: u litsha u tshimbila kana u shuma
u khwaṱhisa tshithu tshi songo wa
rounds.story: 'tshigwada tshashu' na 'muṱangano' zwi sumbedza u imela vhaṅwe.

kids.sentence: Ri tshi khou tamba nnḓa, ḓuvha ḽo fhisa zwihulu.
options: tshifhinga tsha awara dza fumbili na nṋa
kids.story: Maipfi 'ḽo fhisa' na 'nnḓa' a sumbedza ḓuvha ḽa ngei ṱaḓulu.

kids.sentence: Kha mepe iyi, Zimbabwe ndi shango ḽi re tsini na Afrika Tshipembe.
kids.story: 'Zimbabwe' na 'Afrika Tshipembe' zwi sumbedza uri ndi shango ḽa vhathu na muvhuso.

kids.sentence: Ndo hangwa dzina ḽa bugu ye ra i vhala mulovha.
options: ḽe muthu kana tshithu tsha vhidzwa ngalo
ḽine bugu kana luimbo zwa vhidzwa ngaḽo
kids.story: 'bugu' i sumbedza uri hu khou ambiwa dzina kana ṱhoho ya bugu.

kids.sentence: Lufono lwanga lu khou lila kha tafula.
kids.story: 'Lufono' na 'kha tafula' zwi sumbedza mubvumo wa u lila, hu si miṱodzi.

kids.sentence: Ro lala ha makhulu musi mvula i sa athu ima.
kids.story: 'ha makhulu' i sumbedza uri vho fhedza vhusiku henefho.

kids.sentence: O lila ngauri o wa kha mulingo wa mbalo.
options: u shulula u bva kha tshiselo
kids.story: 'mulingo wa mbalo' i sumbedza uri ha ngo pasa.

kids.sentence: Fara galasi nga zwavhuḓi ḽi si wa.
options: u vhamba tshithu tshi no shavha
kids.story: 'galasi' na 'ḽi si wa' zwi sumbedza u khwaṱhisa nga tshanḓa.

kids.sentence: Mmbwa yo dzhena ngomu nnḓuni nga luvhilo.
options: u vha murado wa tshiṅwe tshithu
kids.story: 'ngomu nnḓuni' zwi sumbedza u ya nga ngomu.

options: u vhidzelela muthu nga ipfi kana founu
kids.story: 'mbudzi yashu' na ''Tombi'' zwi sumbedza u ṋea dzina.

kids.sentence: Vhea bugu kha tafula u sa i wiseli fhasi.
kids.story: 'bugu' na 'kha tafula' zwi sumbedza u vhea tshithu fhethu.
